messages:
Riley Chen: Quick weekly account pulse for TidalDeck — token usage spiked WoW +62% (QoQ +18%). Seeing throughput saturation in eu-central. Can ops/infra weigh in? :wave:
Nora White: Thanks Riley. Do we have per-route breakdown? Might be their new contextual search rollout.
Tomás Alvarez: Pulled traces: heavy on /v1/embeddings and /v1/chat/stream. 95p latency jumped 300ms -> 520ms over last 48h. Errors from 0.15% -> 0.9%.
Riley Chen: Oof. Spend? Any commit overrun risk?
Tomás Alvarez: Forecasted month burn ~44% above plan if pattern holds. No hard quota hit yet but burn rate accelerated.
ops-bot: Auto-fallback event: 2026-03-20T08:12Z -> routed 12% traffic to dedicated-eu for capacity. Autoscale added +1 node.
Nora White: Can we throttle non-critical routes temporarily? Also curious avg token lengths.
Tomás Alvarez: Small sanitized sample:
```
route,avg_tokens,qps
chat-stream,34,320
embeddings,142,210
search-rerank,18,60
```
Riley Chen: Embeddings larger token size but chat-stream higher QPS — explains latency.
Tomás Alvarez: Error breakdown: ~65% 429s (rate limiting), ~35% 504/502 (model proxy timeouts). Snip:
```
[2026-03-19T23:02:14Z] 429 client=tidaldeck-app route=/v1/chat/stream
[2026-03-20T01:11:09Z] 504 model-proxy timeout seq=...
```
Nora White: Mitigation suggestions: 1) enable per-session KV prefix caching for chat; 2) bump embeddings batch window 15ms -> 40ms; 3) add transient 10% soft-throttle on rerank route to preserve headroom.
Tomás Alvarez: Ops note: can also apply temporary prefer-variant=gpu-quant for low-latency sessions and allow cpu-quant fallback after 650ms. Will need canary config.
Riley Chen: Sounds good. Renewal perspective: Renewals Manager, FYI — if spend continues at this rate we should flag for conversation asap.
Renewals Manager: Thanks. Please include projected delta and ETA for mitigation. If spend >70% of commit within first 2 weeks of month, I'll open a renewal touch.
CS Engineer: I'll schedule a 20m enablement call with product team (tomorrow). Prefers short syncs.
Tomás Alvarez: Proposing action list: A) Nora enable KV cache + batching change (ETA 3h). B) Tomás deploy canary route (ETA 8h). C) Riley send spending heads-up to TidalDeck with suggested temporary limits (today EOD).
Nora White: I'll add dashboard tiles: 95p latency, 429 rate, per-route QPS, month-to-date burn vs commit.
ops-bot: Suggestion: create alert: spend_rate > projected_commit_rate * 1.25 -> escalate to Renewals Manager.
Riley Chen: If 95p drops by >=20% and 429s <0.5% within 24h, we'll mark as mitigated and cancel escalation.
Tomás Alvarez: Will attach a small eval set (100 prompts) to ensure quantized fallback doesn't regress quality.
Riley Chen: End note: account doc link updated: https://redwood.app/accounts/tidaldeck/health — will post follow-ups after actions. :pushpin:
